expected_outcome: Loads SCS/platform skills, lists GitHub connectors for user choice, drafts a cron pipeline (12 PM EST daily, last-24h repos) with optional one-time full scan for 1k+ repos, attempts harness_create, handles schema/SSCA step validation errors with retries or honest blocking errors, and provides Git-pushable pipeline YAML for Git Experience. turns.content:
I need to create a pipeline to have all github repositories scanned and reports avaiable in Harness SCS module. This pipeline needs to run daily at 12 PM EST and scan all repositories that were touched in last 24 hours. I also want to execute this once to pull results for all 1k + repositories' results to show up once and then this daily job taking care of the new changes in last 24 hours to repos. Sample gh api call for reference. Need a cron trigger. we also have git experience enabled so provide me the pipeline script I can push to github. if you prefer to do it ask me for the connectore with a pre-populated list of connectors for me to chose from.

  -X GET \
  -f q="org:${GITHUB_ORG:-eval_github_org} pushed:>=$(date -u -v-24H +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" \
  --jq '.items[].full_name'
